resources.string: New posts are also published as a public web page at oshi-messenger.com/c/%1$s. Anyone can read them, including search engines and link previews. End-to-end encryption does not apply to the web copy.
Give this channel a public link first: the web preview uses its handle.

Posts in this channel will be visible to anyone on the web at oshi-messenger.com/c/%1$s. New posts only. Link previews (WhatsApp, X, Telegram…) can read them too, and end-to-end encryption does not apply to the web copy.
Every post and image published at oshi-messenger.com/c/%1$s will be removed from the web. Your posts in the app stay as they are.
When off, the pages ask search engines not to list them.
Paste this code into your website where the post should appear.
